Evidence is still thin for sign_in hint changes (only 1 test conducted so far).

Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
carried_retests: Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Customizer Grid
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate step into a full-bleed grid layout with pet personality trait selectors and interactive name styling components.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is low at 60.9% with a long mean duration of 1017s; structured visual personalization speeds up completion and builds emotional connection.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[1]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Desktop Control Overview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated information screen right before home_intro that outlines desktop controls like dragging, right-click menus, and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets, while finish step conversion drops to 64.8%.

new_desktop_overview.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Reference
new_desktop_overview.body: Here is how to interact with your pet once it lands on your screen.

components.text: Right-click pet for settings & hide option

guard.reason: Adding a desktop overview screen before home_intro within onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High step drop-off and support evidence, but adding a new screen increases friction and cost.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to a story scroll format featuring animated previews of each available pet journey.
candidates.why: Path choice step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating lingering and uncertainty when selecting an initial pet path.

guard.reason: The redesigned choose_path screen fails to offer both adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Desktop Wait Preview
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight stage layout with companion setup animations while the desktop environment calibrates.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a high mean of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear; clear visual setup activity reduces drop-off.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Desktop Pet Workspace
waiting.body: Calibrating pet movement bounds and desktop graphics layer...

guard.reason: The redesign changes the waiting screen's purpose to desktop workspace calibration rather than showing that the pet is being made.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Recovery Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text on the sign-in screen urging returning users to use their existing credentials to prevent losing existing pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to instantly sync your saved pet and progress.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync hint to the sign-in screen is permitted and maintains fair design.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence, simple copy change, and positive previous sign_in hint test.

candidates.title: Path Selection Starter Perks Tip
candidates.change: Add a tip carousel component to the path selection screen detailing unique starter items included with each path.
candidates.why: Median choose_path time is 8s while mean is 514s, showing significant user confusion; highlighting perks encourages faster decisions.

choose_path.hint: Every path unlocks exclusive desktop companion accessories and starter items.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions path perks and starter items, violating the prohibition on mentioning gifts or free extras.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Readiness Alert
candidates.change: Add system notification option and display hint to the waiting screen so users know how to locate their pet if it spawns off-screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening during initial render.

waiting.hint: If your pet doesn't appear on screen immediately, check your system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adding helpful display hints and readiness notifications to the waiting screen keeps its core function intact.

candidates.score_note: Addresses off-screen render complaints; previous home wait_info test showed modest positive lift.

candidates.title: Two Column Photo Upload Guidelines
candidates.change: Change upload_photos screen to a two-column layout with photo quality guidelines and bad example illustrations.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets cited custom pet creation failure or distorted pet generation.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo Reference
upload_photos.hint: Upload bright, front-facing photos for the best custom desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a two-column guide preserves its original purpose.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off (60.9%), but previous adoption redesign decreased conversion.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Welcome Copy Update
candidates.change: Update home_intro headline, body, and button label to clearly signal pet activation and immediate desktop interaction.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and overall onboarding conversion is 18.7%; clear call-to-action improves final step completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Click and drag your pet to move it around or right-click for quick actions.

guard.reason: Updating copy for home_intro is an allowed onboarding change.

candidates.score_note: Targets final low-converting finish step (64.8%) with low-cost copy updates.

candidates.title: Pet Selection Starter Companion Badge
candidates.change: Add popular companion recommendation badges and hint text on the pick_friend screen to assist undecided users.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a mean duration of 1017s, indicating decision paralysis during pet selection.

pick_friend.hint: You can adopt additional companions later from your desktop pet collection.

guard.reason: Pressures the user using popularity framing
